description: Comprehensive bloatware rules for Samsung Galaxy smartphones and tablets running One UI.

rules.name: Bixby Voice Agent
rules.description: Primary Bixby voice assistant background service that consumes CPU cycles listening for voice commands.

rules.name: Bixby Voice Wakeup
rules.description: Always-listening hotword microphone detector for 'Hi Bixby'. Disabling saves significant battery life.

rules.name: Bixby Service
rules.description: System integration backbone for Bixby AI features across One UI.

rules.name: Bixby Settings Integration
rules.description: Settings menu preferences for configuring Bixby hardware button remaps and voice settings.

rules.name: Bixby Vision
rules.description: Visual camera shopping, image search, and OCR text translation integration in Samsung Camera.

rules.name: SystemUI Bixby2 Module
rules.description: Hooks Bixby trigger gestures and hardware side-key actions into System UI.

rules.name: Modes and Routines (Bixby Routines)
rules.description: Contextual automation trigger engine based on location and time. Safe to disable if not using automation routines.

rules.name: AR Zone
rules.description: Augmented reality camera hub containing AR Doodle, Deco Pic, Quick Measure, and AR Emoji.

rules.name: AR Emoji Studio
rules.description: 3D animated avatar generation and cartoon selfie styling studio.

rules.name: AR Emoji Editor
rules.description: Customization editor for designing virtual outfits and hairstyle accessories for AR avatars.

rules.name: AR Emoji Stickers
rules.description: Generates animated sticker packs from your AR Emoji for keyboard sharing.

rules.name: Live Stickers
rules.description: Animated camera face filters and animal sticker overlays.

rules.name: Samsung Free / Samsung News
rules.description: Ad-supported news aggregator, sponsored instant games, and podcast feed on the leftmost home screen panel.

rules.name: Samsung Visit In
rules.description: Geofencing marketing daemon that triggers targeted commercial notifications when entering partner shopping malls and stores.

rules.name: Samsung Members
rules.description: Community forum client, hardware diagnostics, and promotional trade-in banner service.

rules.name: Samsung Diagnostic Monitor Agent
rules.description: Background crash log generator, analytics harvester, and telemetry transmitter.

rules.name: Customization Service (Rubin AI)
rules.description: Samsung on-device AI machine learning engine that profiles user behavior, app usage, and search patterns for advertising.

rules.name: Samsung Cloud
rules.description: Samsung proprietary cloud backup service. Safe to remove if using Google Drive / Google Photos.

rules.name: Samsung Core Services
rules.description: Background NLP search indexing, OCR photo search, and deep link provider for Samsung native apps.

rules.name: Samsung Kids Installer
rules.description: Installer stub for the Samsung Kids sandbox environment.

rules.name: Samsung Kids Home
rules.description: Child-friendly sandbox launcher environment. Safe to remove for adult users.

rules.name: Samsung Checkout
rules.description: In-app purchase billing platform for Galaxy Store themes and custom fonts.

rules.name: Gaming Hub (Game Launcher)
rules.description: Gaming library hub that displays sponsored mobile game ads and promotional recommendations.

rules.name: Game Booster (Game Tools)
rules.description: In-game floating toolbar for screen recording, touch lock, and temperature monitoring.

rules.name: Game Optimizing Service (GOS)
rules.description: Performance regulation service that identifies app package IDs and throttles CPU/GPU frequencies.

rules.name: Link to Windows (Phone Link)
rules.description: Background companion daemon that mirrors notifications, SMS, and screen to Microsoft Windows PCs.

rules.name: Link to Windows Service Kit
rules.description: Platform bridge supporting Link to Windows cross-device clipboard and audio streaming.

rules.name: Samsung Quick Share Media Server
rules.description: DLNA media streaming and local device discovery daemon.

rules.name: Samsung Pass
rules.description: Biometric password manager from Samsung. Safe to remove if using Bitwarden, 1Password, or Google Password Manager.

rules.name: Samsung Pass Autofill Engine
rules.description: Credential autofill provider plugin for Samsung Pass.

rules.name: Samsung Wallet (Samsung Pay)
rules.description: Contactless mobile payment and digital wallet app from Samsung. Safe to remove if using Google Wallet.

rules.name: Samsung Pay Framework
rules.description: Card tokenization and security handshake framework for Samsung Pay.

rules.name: Knox Attestation Service
rules.description: Device hardware integrity and enterprise boot-status verifier.

rules.name: Knox Analytics Uploader
rules.description: Enterprise security usage and diagnostic telemetry uploader.

rules.name: Knox Cloud MDM Client
rules.description: Corporate mobile device management enrollment client.

rules.name: Knox BBC Agent
rules.description: Enterprise container monitoring service.

rules.name: Samsung DeX UI Service
rules.description: Desktop PC environment UI shell when connected to external monitors or HDMI docks.

rules.name: DeX on PC
rules.description: USB streaming client for projecting desktop DeX inside a Windows or Mac computer window.

rules.name: Galaxy Store
rules.description: Secondary app market from Samsung. Safe to disable if you install all apps from Google Play Store.

rules.name: Galaxy Themes
rules.description: Storefront for purchasing wallpapers, AOD clocks, and system icon packs.

rules.name: Samsung Tips
rules.description: Tutorial showcase pushing push notification tips after OS updates.

rules.name: Smart Switch
rules.description: Data transfer utility for copying contacts and photos from an old phone during initial unboxing setup.

rules.name: Hiya Smart Call Caller ID
rules.description: Third-party spam database integration that uploads unknown inbound phone numbers to Hiya servers.

rules.name: Call and Text on Other Devices
rules.description: Cloud relay daemon allowing Samsung Galaxy Tab and Galaxy Book to make cellular calls through phone.

rules.name: SmartThings Find (Find My Mobile)
rules.description: Offline finding location beacon network for Samsung devices.
